items.summary: 227 install commands were found in corporate docs pointing at code nobody owns.

items.summary: Without authorization, 1,200 OpenAI agents conspired among themselves to game a test.

items.title: Google’s AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more
items.summary: The updates indicate that Google is looking to position AI Mode as an AI travel agent of sorts, as it's moving beyond simply helping users find information to actually handling parts of the trip-planning and booking process.

items.summary: Presented by EDB As enterprises give AI agents more autonomy — the ability to plan, decide, and act across systems without a human approving each step — a hard question moves to the center of every architecture review: When an agent tries to complete an action that it was neve…

items.summary: The models responsible for last month’s agent hack of Hugging Face had been inadvertently trained to cheat and to communicate with each other, according to an OpenAI technical report released today. The hack, which a group of agents undertook to find solutions for a cybersecur…

items.title: Open-weight AI companies are the Valley’s hottest acquisition targets
items.summary: There's a lot of capital pouring into the business of giving models away.

items.title: Hugging Face is selling a cute $399 open source duck robot, Microduck
items.summary: Clem Delangue, CEO of Hugging Face, said the Microduck is an “open-source robot you can teach new tricks with reinforcement learning.”

items.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
items.summary: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.

items.title: Nvidia’s AI advantage is moving beyond the GPU
items.summary: The new generation of data center systems is increasing efficiency with smarter traffic control instead of just more processor cycles.

items.title: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips
items.summary: Neocloud Lambda has raised $1B in private debt to buy Nvidia AI chips and lease them to Microsoft. It's the latest in a string of loans, underscoring the high cost of the AI boom.

items.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
items.summary: Given 10 benchmarks for specific misaligned behaviors, the automated systems were able to improve performance on every single one without degrading overall performance.

items.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
items.summary: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, handing the AI company a victory as its second Pentagon lawsuit continues in Washington.

items.title: The Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Its First Global South Language
AssessPrep turns test scores into data schools can use; VC inflow into startups sees marginal rise
items.summary: AssessPrep uses AI to create, grade, and analyse tests, helping schools see where students are struggling, and not just what they scored. Venture capital funding into Indian startups rose marginally in the last week of August.

items.title: Myntra Tech Threads 2026 brings brands together to discuss tech-led fashion, beauty and lifestyle commerce

items.title: Andreessen Horowitz raises $1.1 billion for AI infrastructure fund
items.summary: The “Machine Age Fund” will invest in AI computer infrastructure such as chips, memory, networking and storage, the firm said in a blog post on Friday, and will also include data centers, robotics and home appliances.

items.title: Can a cheek swab screen for 7,442 genetic disorders?
items.summary: SugarStrings says its proprietary machine learning-based crawler identifies novel mutations with 94.89% accuracy, allowing it to analyse genetic data across more diverse populations.

items.title: Why logistics AI is becoming the bext big bet for investors
items.summary: AI can read messages, calls, GPS signals, invoices and delivery documents; turn them into structured decisions; and act on them, moving logistics from a system of record to a system of action.

items.title: Marvell selloff deepens as investors seek clarity on Google AI deal payoff
items.summary: Marvell has become a market darling fueled by the AI spending boom as Big Tech races to adopt custom chips for greater cost efficiency and performance, powering ‌its shares ⁠to nearly ⁠triple this year.

items.title: OpenAI to end agreement with SpaceX's AI coding tool Cursor, deepening Musk-Altman clash
items.summary: OpenAI ‌said ​it ​was ⁠not confident that SpaceX ​would use its technology "within ​our terms of service."

careers.note: Demand snapshot for 2026. ML Engineer is the most in-demand AI title; agentic-AI and deep-learning skills carry the highest pay premiums; Python + one cloud is the baseline. Specialisation beats generalisation for freshers.

paths.note: #1 AI title — build, deploy & maintain models in production. Best all-round entry into AI.
RAG, tool-use & multi-agent systems. ~40% of enterprise apps will embed AI agents by year-end.
Neural nets for vision & speech. Highest premiums; usually needs strong maths / grad study.
Ship & scale models on the cloud. Cloud AI certs add 20–25% to salary.
Foundational, widest entry door; a reliable first step into AI.
Imaging, robotics, autonomous systems, medical AI.
Powers chatbots, search & agents — the hottest application area.
5–8 yrs experience; $140k–$332k bands. Translates AI into business value.
Alignment, evals, red-teaming & policy — newer but expanding fast.

fresher.why: The lingua franca of ML — non-negotiable.
Linear algebra, probability & calculus — enough to reason about models.
Regression, classification, evaluation, the ML workflow.
Build & train neural nets; PyTorch dominates research & jobs.
Ship a small LLM app — the most visible skill to recruiters now.
Real AI work is mostly data; SQL is everywhere.
AWS leads (~40% of postings), then Azure & GCP. Version everything.
A deployed project that solves a real problem is the #1 differentiator.

experienced.why: Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, model/versioning — production is where value lives.
Multi-agent orchestration, tool-use, evals — the surging frontier.
AWS/Azure/GCP architecture; certs add a 20–25% salary premium.
Adapt, measure and harden models for a domain.
Cost & latency engineering for large models.
Trade-offs across data, latency, cost & reliability at scale.
CV, NLP, recsys, healthcare — depth beats breadth at senior levels.
Leading teams and tying models to measurable outcomes.
